scope: new batch generic trajectory audit only; no scenario conclusions

primitive_descendant_stages.interpretation: Each stage is nested inclusive/exclusive accounting. Per-stage unions remove same-clock process/thread overlap; unions of different stages are NOT mutually exclusive. Exclusive includes uninstrumented work and logger overhead, not pure compute. Different clock domains are never merged.

episodes.service_scope_note: Only same-kernel spans fully contained in exactly one isolated episode primitive interval. This is temporal attribution; no RPC request-ID causal join is claimed. Init/reset/load spans outside primitive intervals excluded. Do not add this summary to nested primitive totals.

five_bucket_support.interpretation: Synchronous handler runs inside uniquely associated MCP call, then its elapsed duration is stored in the returned step. Semantic containment supported by source plus step association; NOT an independently observed unified-clock partition.
